title: Creating Series: Default vs Custom Indexing
description: Compare default 0-indexed Series with semantically labeled custom indices.
code:
import pandas as pd

# 1. Default integer index
default_s = pd.Series([10, 20, 30])
print("Default Index Series:")
print(default_s)

# 2. Custom string labels
custom_s = pd.Series([85, 92, 78], index=["Arun", "Priya", "Rahul"])
print("\nCustom Labeled Series:")
print(custom_s)

title: Accessing Elements: .loc vs .iloc
description: Retrieve values by name using .loc and by integer offset using .iloc.
code:
import pandas as pd

marks = pd.Series([85, 92, 78, 88], index=["Arun", "Priya", "Rahul", "Meena"])

# Label-based (.loc)
print("Priya's Score (.loc):", marks.loc["Priya"])
print("Multi-Select (.loc):\n", marks.loc[["Arun", "Rahul"]], sep="")

# Position-based (.iloc)
print("\nFirst Student (.iloc[0]):", marks.iloc[0])
print("Last Student (.iloc[-1]): ", marks.iloc[-1])
print("Sliced (.iloc[1:3]):\n", marks.iloc[1:3], sep="")

title: Modifying Series and Appending Labels
description: Mutate existing values and expand a Series dynamically with new labels.
code:
import pandas as pd

scores = pd.Series([80, 70, 90], index=["Maths", "English", "Science"])
print("Original Series:\n", scores, sep="")

# Update English in-place
scores.loc["English"] = 85

# Add Computer as a new subject
scores.loc["Computer"] = 95

print("\nModified & Expanded Series:\n", scores, sep="")

title: Series Arithmetic & Summary Statistics
description: Apply vectorized scalar calculations and compute essential descriptive statistics.
code:
import pandas as pd

sales = pd.Series([1000, 1500, 1200, 1800], index=["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu"])

# 10% bonus scaling
scaled_sales = sales * 1.10
print("10% Scaled Sales:\n", scaled_sales, sep="")

# Summary stats
print("\nTotal Sales:  ", sales.sum())
print("Average Sales:", sales.mean())
print("Peak Day:     ", sales.max())
print("Slowest Day:  ", sales.min())
